d.ko: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?
d.en: Successor to the roguelike RPG "Elona". Adventure, survival, crafting, home-building, myths passed down, and stories of humans and Elea spun. What scars will you leave on the land of Ylva?
d.zh: 本作是Rougelike型RPG「Elona」的续作。这是一款集冒险，生活，制造，建设家园玩法为一体的沙盒游戏。故事将以悠远的神话为背景，围绕人类与艾莱亚两个种族拉开故事的帷幕。你会在这片伊尔瓦的大地上留下怎样的伤痕呢？
